answer_1.quote: We conduct an empirical study to benchmark the performances of some existing methods on three challenging tasks against our dataset: (1) stance detection; (2) abstractive summarization; and (3) stance-specific summarization...
answer_1.outputs: Stance-specific summaries and overall summaries (short and long) generated by summarization models

answer_2.quote: We choose the well-established ROUGE scores as automatic evaluation metrics and report standard F1 scores of ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L.

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a human evaluation on generated summaries. The evaluators were requested to rate the generated summaries by four aspects: conciseness, fluency, faithfulness and informativeness, following a 1 to 5 rating scale.
answer_4.guideline: Rate each generated summary on conciseness, fluency, faithfulness (non‑hallucination) and informativeness using a 1‑5 scale; overall score is the average of the four aspects.
